  body: {
    content: 'We just launched',

  },
});

    npm install @zernio/node

import Zernio from '@zernio/node';

const zernio = new Zernio(); // reads ZERNIO_API_KEY

await zernio.posts.createPost({
  body: {
    content: 'Hello from Zernio',
    platforms: [{ platform: 'linkedin', accountId: 'YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID' }],
    publishNow: true,
  },
});
